data.name: Sidebar.LatestNews

data.name: Sidebar.InstallButton
data.comment: Label of the big button that installs a version. Write it in capital letters. The button has room for about 8 characters, a longer word is shrunk until it is hard to read, so use a short word or an abbreviation.

data.name: Sidebar.UpdateButton
data.comment: Label of the big button that updates the installed version. Write it in capital letters. The button has room for about 8 characters, a longer word is shrunk until it is hard to read, so use a short word or an abbreviation.

data.name: Sidebar.CancelButton
data.comment: Label of the big button that cancels the running install, or stops the running game. Write it in capital letters. The button has room for about 8 characters, a longer word is shrunk until it is hard to read, so use a short word or an abbreviation.

data.name: Sidebar.LaunchButton
data.comment: Label of the big button that starts the game. Write it in capital letters. The button has room for about 8 characters, a longer word is shrunk until it is hard to read, so use a short word or an abbreviation.

data.name: Sidebar.Link.Website.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the link icon that opens the project website.

data.name: Sidebar.Link.Discord.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the link icon that opens the Discord server.

data.name: Sidebar.Link.Forums.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the link icon that opens the forum thread.

data.name: Community.ViewOnBlog.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the button next to a news post title that opens the post in the browser.

data.name: Mods.ComingSoon
data.comment: Large heading on the Mods tab, which has no content yet.

data.name: Mods.Roadmap
data.value: Mod support is on the roadmap :3

data.name: Home.Progress.Downloaded

data.name: Home.Progress.Installed

data.name: Home.LauncherUpdateNeeded

data.name: Settings.Title
data.comment: Heading of the Settings tab, shown in capital letters.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Section
data.comment: Heading of the settings section for the selected KSP2 install. A profile is the launcher's saved entry for one copy of the game.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Label
data.comment: Label of the drop-down that selects the install profile.

data.name: Settings.Profile.NamePlaceholder
data.comment: Hint shown in the empty text box while a profile is being renamed.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Rename.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the pencil button next to the profile drop-down.

data.name: Settings.Profile.RenameSave.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the check mark button shown while a profile is being renamed. Enter and Esc are keyboard keys.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Add
data.comment: Button that adds a profile for another KSP2 install.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Add.Tooltip
data.value: Add a profile for another KSP2 install on this computer
data.comment: Tooltip of the Add button.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Remove
data.comment: Button that removes the selected profile from the launcher.

data.name: Settings.Profile.Remove.Tooltip
data.value: Remove this profile from the launcher. The game files are left where they are.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Remove button.

data.name: Settings.Profile.OpenFolder
data.comment: Button that opens the game's install folder in the file browser.

data.name: Settings.Profile.OpenFolder.Tooltip
data.value: Open this install's folder in your file browser.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Open Folder button.

data.name: Settings.Profile.DownloadKsp2
data.comment: Button in the profile section that downloads the game from Steam. Its tooltip is set elsewhere.

data.name: Settings.Exe.Label
data.comment: Label of the text box that holds the path of KSP2_x64.exe.

data.name: Settings.Exe.Browse
data.comment: Button next to the game executable path that opens a file picker.

data.name: Settings.Exe.Browse.Tooltip
data.value: Find KSP2_x64.exe with the file browser
data.comment: Tooltip of the Browse button. KSP2_x64.exe is a file name.

data.name: Settings.Channel.Label
data.comment: Label of the drop-down that selects where Redux versions are taken from, for example stable or snapshot.

data.name: Settings.LaunchViaSteam.Label
data.comment: Label of a check box. When ticked, the game is started through the Steam client.

data.name: Settings.LaunchViaSteam.Tooltip
data.value: Start KSP2 through the Steam client instead of running KSP2_x64.exe directly.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Launch via Steam label. KSP2_x64.exe is a file name.

data.name: Settings.SteamAppId.Label
data.comment: Label of the text box that holds the Steam application number of the game.

data.name: Settings.SteamAppId.Tooltip
data.value: Override to launch a Steam 'Add a Non-Steam Game' shortcut for KSP2. Leave as 954850 for the normal Steam release.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Steam app id label. 'Add a Non-Steam Game' is the name of a Steam menu entry, translate it like Steam does.

data.name: Settings.LaunchArguments.Label
data.comment: Label of the text box with extra command line arguments for the game.

data.name: Settings.LaunchArguments.Tooltip
data.value: Arguments passed to KSP2_x64.exe on launch. Ignored when 'Launch via Steam' is enabled.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Launch arguments label. 'Launch via Steam' is the label of another setting on the same page, use the same wording.

data.name: Settings.DisableGfxJobs.Label
data.comment: Label of a check box that turns off Unity graphics jobs.

data.name: Settings.DisableGfxJobs.Tooltip
data.value: Disable Unity graphics jobs by setting gfx-enable-gfx-jobs=0 in boot.config. Workaround for crashes on some hardware.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Disable gfx jobs label. gfx-enable-gfx-jobs=0 and boot.config are literal settings, do not translate them.

data.name: Settings.InstallPatch.Button
data.comment: Button that installs Redux from a .patch file picked on disk.

data.name: Settings.InstallPatch.Tooltip
data.value: Install Redux from a .patch file you already have
data.comment: Tooltip of the Install Patch File button.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.Button
data.comment: Button that removes Redux and restores the unmodified game.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.Tooltip
data.value: Put the game back to stock KSP2
data.comment: Tooltip of the Uninstall Redux button. Stock means the unmodified game.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Button
data.comment: Button that deletes the whole game folder of the selected profile.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.ButtonBusy
data.comment: Text of the Uninstall KSP2 button while the game folder is being deleted.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Tooltip
data.value: Delete this copy of KSP2 from the computer and remove its profile. Saves are kept.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Uninstall KSP2 button.

data.name: Settings.Advanced.Section
data.comment: Heading of the settings section about how patches are downloaded.

data.name: Settings.PatchSource.Label
data.comment: Label of the drop-down that selects the download service.

data.name: Settings.PatchSource.Tooltip
data.value: R2 is the primary download service. Select GitHub to use the permanent backup copies.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Patch source drop-down. R2 and GitHub are the names of the two choices.

data.name: Settings.ConcurrentChunks.Label
data.comment: Label of the number box that sets how many pieces of a patch download at the same time.

data.name: Settings.ConcurrentChunks.Tooltip
data.comment: Tooltip of the Concurrent chunks number box.

data.name: Settings.Language.Label
data.comment: Label of the drop-down that selects the language of the launcher. Only shown once at least one translation exists.

data.name: Settings.Language.Automatic
data.comment: First entry of the language drop-down. Means the launcher uses the language of the operating system.

data.name: Settings.OpenLogsFolder
data.comment: Button that opens the folder with the launcher's log files.

data.name: Settings.OpenGameDataFolder
data.comment: Button that opens the folder where KSP2 keeps its saves and settings.

data.name: Settings.OpenGameDataFolder.Tooltip
data.value: Open the folder KSP2 keeps its saves, settings and its own Player.log in.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Open Game Data Folder button. Player.log is a file name.

data.name: Settings.CopyDiagnosticInfo
data.comment: Button that copies version, system and log information to the clipboard for bug reports.

data.name: Settings.VerboseLogging
data.comment: Label of a check box.

data.name: Settings.VerboseLogging.Tooltip
data.value: Write more detailed information to the log file. Useful when troubleshooting an issue.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Verbose logging check box.

data.name: Settings.BackgroundMotion
data.comment: Label of a check box.

data.name: Settings.BackgroundMotion.Tooltip
data.value: Shift the background slightly as the mouse moves. Turn this off if the motion is distracting or uncomfortable.
data.comment: Tooltip of the Background motion check box.

data.name: Settings.LauncherVersion
data.comment: Small text at the bottom right of the Settings tab. {0} = launcher version number.

data.name: Common.Cancel
data.comment: Button that abandons the current window or action.

data.name: Common.Close
data.comment: Button that closes a window once its work has stopped.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Title
data.comment: Title bar of the Steam sign-in window.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Heading
data.comment: Heading inside the Steam sign-in window, shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Intro
data.value: Redux downloads your own copy of Kerbal Space Program 2 straight from Steam. Sign in with the account that owns the game.
data.comment: Explanation under the heading of the Steam sign-in window.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.GettingCode
data.comment: Shown in the empty square where the QR code appears, until Steam has sent the code.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.ScanTitle
data.comment: Heading under the QR code.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.ScanHint
data.value: In the Steam Mobile App, open Steam Guard and tap the QR scanner.
data.comment: Instruction under the QR code. Steam Mobile App and Steam Guard are Steam names, translate them like Steam does.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Or
data.comment: Separator between the QR code and the password form.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.AccountName
data.comment: Small label above the account name text box, shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Password
data.comment: Small label above the password text box, shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.SignInButton
data.comment: Button that signs in with the typed account name and password.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.SigningIn
data.comment: Shown while Steam checks the password.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.SteamGuard
data.comment: Heading of the step where Steam asks for a second proof of identity. Shown in capital letters. Steam Guard is a Steam name.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Continue
data.comment: Button that sends the typed Steam Guard code.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.EnterCredentials
data.value: Enter your Steam account name and password.
data.comment: Error shown when the account name or the password was left empty.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Failed
data.comment: Error shown when signing in failed. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.EmailCode
data.value: Steam sent a code to {0}. Enter it below.
data.comment: Prompt for the Steam Guard code sent by email. {0} = the email address.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.EmailCodeWrong
data.value: That code didn't work. Enter the new code Steam sent to {0}.
data.comment: Prompt shown after a wrong emailed Steam Guard code. {0} = the email address.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.DeviceCode
data.value: Enter the code shown in your Steam Mobile App.
data.comment: Prompt for the Steam Guard code from the phone app.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.DeviceCodeWrong
data.value: That code didn't work. Enter the current code from your Steam Mobile App.
data.comment: Prompt shown after a wrong Steam Guard code from the phone app.

data.name: Steam.SignIn.Approve
data.value: Open the Steam Mobile App and approve the sign-in.
data.comment: Prompt shown while waiting for the sign-in to be approved on the phone.

data.name: Steam.Download.Title
data.comment: Title bar of the window that downloads the game from Steam.

data.name: Steam.Download.Target
data.comment: Line under the stage heading. {0} = the folder the game is downloaded into.

data.name: Steam.Download.Hint
data.value: You can stop and come back later. Finished files are kept and the download picks up where it left off.
data.comment: Small note at the bottom of the download window.

data.name: Steam.Download.Stage.Connecting
data.comment: Heading of the download window before the download starts. Shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.Download.Stage.Downloading
data.comment: Heading of the download window while files download. Shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.Download.Stage.Finished
data.comment: Heading of the download window when everything is downloaded. Shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.Download.Stage.Stopped
data.comment: Heading of the download window after an error. Shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.Download.Detail
data.comment: Progress line of the download window. {0} = size downloaded, for example 1.2 GB. {1} = total size. {2} = speed, see Steam.Download.Speed. {3} = files done. {4} = files in total.

data.name: Steam.Download.Speed
data.comment: Download speed. {0} = size per second, for example 12.3 MB.

data.name: Steam.Download.Measuring
data.comment: Shown in place of the download speed until enough data has arrived to work it out.

data.name: Steam.Download.MissingExe
data.value: The download finished but {0} is missing from it.
data.comment: Error shown when the downloaded folder has no game executable. {0} = the executable's file name.

data.name: Steam.Download.Stage.Checking
data.comment: Heading of the download window while the launcher checks that the account owns the game. Shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.Download.Stage.Reading
data.comment: Heading of the download window while the launcher reads the list of game files from Steam. Shown in capital letters.

data.name: Steam.FolderPicker.Title

data.comment: Title of the folder picker that asks where the game is downloaded to.

data.name: Dialog.Confirm.Title

data.name: Dialog.Done.Title
data.comment: Title of a message box that reports success.

data.comment: Name of the only file type in the picker that selects a .patch file.

data.name: Settings.FilePicker.Patch.Title
data.comment: Title of the file picker that selects a .patch file.

data.name: Settings.RemoveProfile.Message
data.value: Are you sure you want to remove "{0}"? Its name, launch arguments, and Steam settings will be lost.
data.comment: Yes/No question before a profile is removed. {0} = the profile name.

data.name: Settings.OpenInstallFolder.NotFound
data.value: The install folder could not be found.
data.comment: Message box text when the Open Folder button finds no folder.

data.name: Settings.OpenInstallFolder.Failed
data.value: Could not open the install folder. {0}
data.comment: Message box text when the install folder could not be opened. Two lines. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: Settings.GameData.Unknown
data.value: The game data folder could not be worked out for this install.
data.comment: Message box text when the launcher cannot tell where KSP2 keeps its saves for the selected profile.

data.name: Settings.GameData.NotYet.Title
data.comment: Title of a message box shown when the game data folder does not exist yet.

data.name: Settings.GameData.NotYet.Message
data.value: KSP2 has not created its data folder yet. Run the game once and it will appear at {0}
data.comment: Message box text. Two lines. {0} = the folder path that will exist after the game ran once.

data.name: Settings.GameData.OpenFailed
data.value: Could not open the game data folder. {0}
data.comment: Message box text when the game data folder could not be opened. Two lines. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: Settings.LogsFolder.Failed
data.comment: Message box text when the logs folder could not be opened. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.NotAGameFolder.Title
data.comment: Title of a message box shown when the profile's folder does not look like a KSP2 install.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.NotAGameFolder.Message
data.value:
{0}
doesn't look like a KSP2 install folder (there is no {1} with KSP2_x64_Data beside it), so nothing was deleted. Remove the profile instead if it points at the wrong place.
data.comment: Message box text. {0} = the folder path, shown on its own first line. {1} = the game executable file name. KSP2_x64_Data is a folder name.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Missing.Title
data.comment: Title of a Yes/No box shown when the game folder of the profile no longer exists.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Missing.Message
data.value: The game folder for "{0}" no longer exists. Remove the profile from the launcher?
data.comment: Yes/No question. {0} = the profile name.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Confirm.Title
data.comment: Title of the Yes/No boxes that ask whether to uninstall the game.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.ThroughSteam.Message
data.value:
This copy of KSP2 is managed by Steam, so Steam will uninstall it and ask you to confirm there. The "{0}" profile is removed from the launcher.
Your saves and settings are kept.
data.comment: Yes/No question for a game installed by Steam. {0} = the profile name.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.SteamFailed
data.value: Couldn't open Steam to uninstall KSP2: {0}
data.comment: Message box text. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Confirm.Message
data.value:
Delete Kerbal Space Program 2 from this computer?
{0}
The whole folder is deleted, Redux included, and the "{1}" profile is removed. This can't be undone.
Your saves and settings are stored elsewhere and are kept.
data.comment: Yes/No question before the game folder is deleted. {0} = the folder path, on its own line. {1} = the profile name.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Failed
data.value:
Couldn't finish uninstalling KSP2: {0}
Make sure the game isn't running, then try again.
data.comment: Message box text when deleting the game folder failed. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: Settings.UninstallKsp2.Done
data.comment: Message box text after the game folder was deleted.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.NoInstall
data.comment: Message box text when Uninstall Redux is used without a selected profile.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.NotInstalled
data.comment: Message box text when Uninstall Redux is used on a game without Redux.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.Confirm
data.value: Are you sure you want to uninstall Redux?
data.comment: Yes/No question before Redux is removed.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.Failed
data.comment: Message box text when removing Redux failed. {0} = the reason.

data.name: Settings.UninstallRedux.Done
data.comment: Message box text after Redux was removed.

data.name: Settings.SnapshotWarning.Title
data.comment: Title of the warning shown when the release channel is switched to snapshot. Snapshot is the name of the test channel.

data.value:
The snapshot channel is for QA testing. Builds are unstable and can break at any time.
We recommend not using it with existing campaigns.
data.comment: Text of the warning shown when the release channel is switched to snapshot. A campaign is a saved game.

data.name: Settings.Exe.Error.Required

data.comment: Red error under the game executable path. {0} = the executable file name.

data.name: Settings.SteamAppId.Error.NotNumeric
